neoboost 0.2.1 Changelog

- No file changes detected in this version.
- No changes to user-facing features, APIs, or documentation.
- Version number updated only; functionality remains the same.

- Expanded and clarified the description to include GEO/NeoBoost data and detailed trigger scenarios.
- Added detailed API documentation for retrieving account info, brand overview, competitor data, and prompt snapshots.
- Included markdown templates and strict formatting guides for presenting overview results.
- Enhanced setup instructions and provided configuration examples for `NEOBOOST_API_KEY`.
- Updated dependencies and setup metadata to support easier installation and configuration.

neoboost 0.1.0 — 初始发布

- 新增品牌AI洞察能力，可查询品牌可见度、健康度、快照等
- 支持管理品牌主题词、提问词、竞品、素材与别名
- 集成AI内容生成及优化功能
- 需配置 NEOBOOST_API_KEY 环境变量
- 提供详细 API 使用和 curl 请求示例
